description.text:
A high-class pack released on 28 November 2025. It brought the new Mega Evolution Pokémon ex Mega Dragonite ex, Mega Eelektross ex and Mega Froslass ex, with cards that help them, such as Dragonair, whose Ability takes an Evolution Pokémon from the deck while it has Energy attached, and the Supporter Canari, which takes up to four Lightning Pokémon from the deck. New cards strengthened decks of N's Pokémon, such as N's Zekrom, N's Vanilluxe and Anthea & Concordia, which under strict conditions lets its player take three more Prize cards when an attack by N's Pokémon knocks out the opponent's Active Pokémon, and of Team Rocket's Pokémon, such as Team Rocket's Honchkrow and Team Rocket's Dugtrio. Strong cards that did well at events came back too, among them Pokémon ex of the Scarlet & Violet series, though no ACE SPEC cards. Each pack held ten cards, at least one of them a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex or Pokémon ex. The cards are numbered to 193, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Trainer cards, Mega Attack Rare cards, Special Art Rare cards, and Mega Dragonite ex as a Mega Ultra Rare. In English many of its cards came out in Ascended Heroes in January 2026.

MEGA Dream ex brought a new rarity, the Mega Attack Rare (MA): specially illustrated cards of Mega Evolution Pokémon unleashing powerful attacks, recalling the design of the M Evolution Pokémon cards of the XY series, for ten Mega Evolution Pokémon ex such as Mega Charizard X ex, Mega Lucario ex and Mega Gardevoir ex. Beside its ordinary cards the pack holds premium mirror versions patterned with Energy symbols or with Poké Balls of many kinds, among them the Love Ball, Friend Ball, Quick Ball and Dusk Ball, and Team Rocket's cards patterned with the Team Rocket logo.
